question: Who among the following revolutionaries was popularly known as 'Master Da'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Surya Sen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Surya Sen was popularly known as 'Master Da'**__.

 __
 
• **Surya Sen**, also called Surya Kumar Sen (22 March 1894 – 12 January 1934), was an Indian revolutionary who was influential in the Indian independence movement against British rule in India and is best known for leading the 1930 Chittagong armoury raid.
 
• Sen was a school teacher by profession and was popularly known as **Master Da**.
 
• He was influenced by nationalist ideals in 1916 while he was a student of B.A. in Berhampore College (Now Krishnath College).
 
• In 1918, he was selected as **president of the Indian National Congress's Chittagong branch**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ashfaqulla Khan** was an Indian independence activist in the Indian independence movement and co-founder of the Hindustan Socialist Republican Association.
 
• **Batukeshwar Dutt **was an Indian socialist revolutionary and independence fighter in the early 1900s.
 
 
• He is best known for having exploded two bombs, along with Bhagat Singh, in the Central Legislative Assembly in New Delhi on 8 April 1929.
 
 
 
• **Ram Prasad Bismil** was an Indian revolutionary who participated in the Mainpuri Conspiracy of 1918, and the Kakori Conspiracy of 1925, and fought against British rule in India.
 
 
• Pandit Ram Prasad Bismil was a freedom fighter who played an active role in India's freedom struggle.
